metrics.profile_summary: Digital Marketing professional with a BBA in Marketing and a Diploma in Digital Marketing. Experienced in social media management, paid campaigns, and market research across agency and corporate environments.

education.institution: University of Engineering and Technology, Lahore
education.degree: Bachelors in Business Administration in Marketing

experience.description: Managed social media pages, executed paid Google Ads and PPC campaigns, and developed content for websites and social platforms.
Assisted with promotional activities, organized marketing research, and created SEO-friendly content.
Developed new product marketing strategies, managed ATL/BTL activities, and conducted market research and ad design.
Planned marketing initiatives and identified potential markets through digital research and analysis.
Researched digital trends and competitor strategies and worked on social media content creation.
Advised on content strategies for social media and blogs and provided promotional strategy consultation.
Supported digital project execution, tracked timelines and budgets for marketing initiatives.

strengths: Direct experience in SMM and competitor research
Diverse portfolio including agency and corporate experience
weaknesses: No explicit mention of Meta Business Suite, Canva, or Excel
Early career consists of many short-term internships
evaluation.summary: The candidate meets all core requirements, including the degree and minimum experience. Their background in SMM, content creation, and market research aligns perfectly with the job duties.
